card.name: 'From' after derived or sourced, animal origin
card.fires_on: The word 'from' right after 'derived', 'made' or 'sourced' when a product's animal or human tissue origin is being stated. Weaker hits on 'to' in 'sensitivity to proteins of porcine origin' and on digits in pancreatic enzyme dosing.

modes.label: Source of the product
modes.description: 'from' after derived, made or sourced, just before an animal or human tissue source.
modes.example: Because Heparin Sodium in 5% Dextrose Injection is derived<< from>> animal tissue, monitor for signs and symptoms

modes.label: Porcine sensitivity
modes.description: 'to' after sensitivity, before proteins of pig origin.
modes.example: or sensitivity<< to>> proteins of porcine origin.

modes.label: Enzyme dose digits
modes.description: A digit inside lipase unit dose numbers for pancreatic enzymes.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward naming an animal source next, such as rat, cow, mouse or pig.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a label says a product comes from animal or human tissue, so an animal name is likely to follow.
